reviews.text: Our dog has been going for about five years. Sarah and her crew are amazing. Also the Instagram content is next level and always gets a laugh.
Our puppy loved it here she even got a little bandanna and staff were very nice
Our dog Waffles loves going to play and is treated so well by all the staff! Highly professional and caring

I’ve had three terriers who went to different daycare‘s, which were fine but nothing like this one. I cannot say enough about the staff particularly Sarah. It’s a welcoming space and I love to feed the fact that we get the agility sessions are really fun for my lovely Luna.

We have been bringing our little dog here for some time now and love it. The staff are amazing with all the dogs and are very attentive. Everytime we show up, our dog just runs in with no hesitation and I think that is the best review she can give.

I cannot recommend Petite Paws Playcare enough, and especially Sara, for the incredible care and understanding they provide. When I was looking for a daycare for my dog, Coconut, it was so important to find a place that truly understands not every dog is ready for daycare, and that slow introductions are key. Sara and her team completely get it. They take the time to ensure that dogs are not pushed past their comfort zones, which is essential not only for the dog’s physical and mental well-being but also for the safety and happiness of all the other dogs in the daycare.

Coconut is a rescue who joined our family in July and came with separation anxiety due to his past experiences. Since starting daycare at Petite Paws, his anxiety has improved dramatically. This has been in conjunction with his ongoing training and veterinary care. I genuinely believe the patience and care that Sara and the team provide have been instrumental in his progress.

If you’re looking for a daycare that prioritizes your dog’s well-being and provides a thoughtful, gradual approach to introductions, Petite Paws Playcare is the place to go. I am so grateful for Sara and the whole team for giving Coconut the time, attention, and support he needs to thrive.
My puppy is always extremely happy to go there. They are very patient and there's always someone checking on the pups in the playground.

Best small dog daycare in Vancouver hands down. My pup loves coming here once a week and Sara (the manager) is amazing with him and he absolutely adores her. I would recommend this place to my closest family and friends :)

We have tried a couple of pet daycares but Petite Paws is by far the BEST! My pup Riley loves to come here!! She comes once/week for the morning. She gets so excited when we walk towards it (she knows the route!) or park the car because she knows where we are and loves to see her friends. She’s  getting great socialization and is around a fantastic bunch of people who truly love dogs and love what they do. So happy to have found this wonderful place!

Sara and her team are so caring, and professional -- you can tell they're truly the best kind of dog people. The prices are reasonable and they offer packages. This is a wonderful place to take your pup.

I refer all my puppy friends at the park.
Amazing daycare! Everyone at the playcare is super helpful and honest. I will continue to recommend this place to my friends with small dogs. 💖 …
